svg.aria-label: Siddharth Abbineni: code, cloud, AI automation and open source. An illustration of how I think about automation: infrastructure and application delivery connect through environment readiness, with AI assistance, human review, verification and feedback.

g.text: code · cloud · ai automation · open source

svg.text: ai coordinates · humans approve · pipelines enforce
map dependencies · draft IaC / code / tests · explain plans · coordinate runs
scoped tools + runbooks · investigate failures · propose fixes · summarize evidence
fresh plan + approval per env: dev → stage → prod
reuse existing infra when dependencies are unchanged
ops → AI correlates alerts + drift → app / IaC fix PRs → same checks + approvals
approved runbooks automate routine ops · exceptions escalate
